item.title: EP15: Opera Acoustics and the Singer's Formant
item.description: Overview An opera singer has no microphone. A single voice must cut through 110 orchestral instruments in a live hall. This episode asks: how? 中文: “答案藏在——3000赫兹。乐队能量在这里暴跌18分贝。这是歌手唯一的窗口——或者被淹没，或者穿透。” The answer is not louder singing. It is frequency targeting: the singer concentrates acoustic energy precisely where the orchestra is weakest, where the human ear is most sensitive, and where the physics of the vocal tract allows a structural resonance enhancement.
